name: legal-consulting-team
description: A multi-role legal consulting expert team that distills Chinese laws and regulations, searches similar cases, and provides solutions, risk assessment, contract review, document drafting and litigation strategy.

displayDescription.en: A professional legal consulting team that interprets Chinese laws and regulations, and provides contract review, document drafting, case analysis, risk assessment and litigation strategy advice.
displayDescription.zh: 专业法律咨询团队，解读国内法律法规，提供合同审查、文书起草、案例分析、风险评估与诉讼策略建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我遇到了一起劳动纠纷，公司拖欠工资还不签合同，我该怎么维权？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a labor dispute - my employer withholds wages and refuses to sign a contract. How can I protect my rights?
